thread:
Mira: spotted partner webhook payloads in staging logs with a Vault ciphertext and an Authorization header that looks like a GKE OIDC token. snippet (redacted):
```
2026-11-02T09:47:12Z POST /hooks/receiver partner=beta-co status=200 auth="Bearer ya29.REDACTED" payload="{\"payload\":\"vault:v1:ENC[...]\"}"
```
Mira: logs are in gs://staging-ingest/logs/partner-hooks/2026-11-02/
Jamal: ack. Is this limited to staging or did the export pull prod too?
Mira: quick grep across prod exports -> nothing. seems staging-only; partner did a replay test yesterday per their ops message.
Ops Oncall: quarantining path now, copying to gs://incident-hold/1766129999/
Ops Oncall: command: `gsutil -m cp -n gs://staging-ingest/logs/partner-hooks/2026-11-02/* gs://incident-hold/1766129999/ && gsutil rm -r gs://staging-ingest/logs/partner-hooks/2026-11-02/*`
sec-bot: alert triggered: webhook-ciphertext-detect (rule id 47). runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/secret-exposure
Samir: running artifact scan across ci-buckets for "vault:v1:" and the partner ID; will post results.
Samir: found 3 artifacts in gs://ci-artifacts/staging/build-2982/ (build.log, delivery.json, hook_dump.txt). uploading filenames to ticket 2026-SEC-1188.
Alex: token decodes to `system:serviceaccount:staging:webhook-processor` via Workload Identity. no long-lived SA keys, but tokens can be minted by CI.
Taylor: Vault transit path in header: `transit/encoders/webhooks-v1`. Alex, does that map to KMS key ring `webhook-transit`?
Alex: yes, our Vault transit backend uses KMS key `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/webhook-transit/cryptoKeys/wt-master`. Options: rotate master key version (create new version) or create new KMS key and update mapping. For staging-only exposure, rotating key version + re-encrypting critical objects on request is fine.
Jamal: containment plan:
- quarantine blob copies (Ops) (done)
- revoke/disable WIF token minting for the staging service account (Alex)
- enable Vault + Cloud KMS audit sinks and increase retention for this incident (Taylor)
- contact partner (beta-co) to rotate webhook secret and confirm no retention (Mira)
- scan CI and artifact stores for other ciphertexts (Samir)
Mira: contacted partner ops@beta-co with minimal disclosure (time window + request to rotate). they confirmed they used test traffic only.
Alex: proposed RBAC change: temporarily remove IAM binding that allows the GitHub Actions principal to impersonate the GKE SA. I'll open a terraform PR in infra/iam with an emergency label.
Ops Oncall: PR opened: infra#8124 remove-github-actions-wif-staging. tag `security/emergency`. starting apply once approved.
Taylor: enabled Vault audit: `vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault/audit-webhooks-1766129999.log format=json` and configured log shipper to copy to incident-hold in real time.
sec-bot: disclosure checklist updated and severity set to S2. incident ticket: 2026-SEC-1188.
Samir: artifact scan results only show staging buckets; no prod exposure. linking artifact paths to the ticket.
Jamal: Rotation decision: rotate Vault transit mapping to new KMS key version. For staging-only, no mandatory rewrap unless partner requests. We will, however, require partners to rotate their HMAC/webhook secrets.
Mira: steps to rotate:
1) block token minting (apply PR)
2) create new KMS key version or new key and update Vault mapping
3) bump transit backend alias `webhooks-v1` to point to new KMS key version
4) ask partner to rotate their webhook secret and confirm
5) re-enable WIF binding with enforced IAM conditions and least privilege
Alex: also propose adding an IAM condition limiting token exchange to the GitHub Actions repo SHA range and adding a KMS key policy to require CMEK for rewrap ops.
Ops Oncall: apply succeeded for temporary WIF removal; minting should be blocked. will monitor for token exchange attempts.
Taylor: current audit shows 0 decrypt/unwrap operations from external IPs. internal activity limited to CI builds captured in quarantined artifacts.
Mira: I've uploaded scrubbed command history and quarantined object list to ticket 2026-SEC-1188 and notified partner. will keep this channel updated.
Jamal: owners:
- Ops Oncall: quarantine copies + backup (done)
- Samir: artifact scan and ticket attachments (done)
- Alex: terraform PR + reapply plan (in progress)
- Taylor: audit config + retention extension (done)
- Mira: partner coordination + confirmation (in progress)
Jamal: timeline: containment <30m, rotation start in 2h, partner rotate within 6h, verification + postmortem next business day.
Alex: follow-ups: add pre-commit lint to CI to flag `vault:v1:` patterns, and enforce artifact retention policy for staging builds.
Taylor: I'll own the postmortem and remediation follow-ups.
sec-bot: incident channel mirror created: #inc-2026-1188. severity S2.
Mira: thanks. once KMS mapping is switched I'll do a smoke test against staging webhooks and confirm partner callback success. moving sensitive diffs to ticket attachments only. :thumbsup:
